channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Italians killed in Kuwait: Why is Iran denying responsibility?
item.description: Iran has openly claimed its strikes on Gulf states throughout the war. So why is it denying an attack on Kuwait?

item.title: Australia sanctions suspects in Iran-linked anti-Semitic attacks
item.description: Sanctions aim to restrict funds for two men alleged to have planned attacks for IRGC.

item.title: ‘I cannot go to work’: Iranians contend with pollution as well as US war
item.description: Hospital admissions for respiratory ailments have soared as the winter smog sets in.

item.title: Democrats want to end Trump’s Iran war. But how different are they?
item.description: Decades of bipartisan pressure on Tehran raises questions about how far Democrats are willing to change US policy.

item.title: Can the Mecca pact turn its collective defence promise into real support?
item.description: Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and Turkiye meet in Islamabad as Houthi attacks on the kingdom continue and Iran talks stay open.

item.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
item.description: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.

item.title: Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31
item.description: Officials say the man confessed to travelling at speed and clipping the fuel truck as he was overtaking traffic.

item.title: Inside Saudi Arabia, Houthi attacks test kingdom's image of security
item.description: Despite the strikes, markets and restaurants in Riyadh remain busy as residents express trust in the government to protect them.

item.title: Desperate appeals from women on death row in Iran after protests
item.description: Female protesters and dissidents are being sentenced to death in numbers not seen for decades, a rights group says.
